steps: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lower your hips down and back as if sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through the floor to return to standing.
breathing: Exhale as you stand back up.
careful_about: Do not let your heels lift off the ground.
Avoid collapsing your knees inward.
Keep your back neutral and do not round forward.

steps: Hold one dumbbell close to your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a deep squat while keeping the weight close.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
careful_about: Keep the dumbbell tight to your chest.
Do not let your lower back round.
Keep knees aligned with toes.

steps: Place the back foot on a chair or bench.
Step the front foot forward far enough to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is near parallel.
Push through the front foot to return up.
careful_about: Keep most of the weight on the front leg.
Do not let the front knee cave inward.
Use support if balance is difficult.

steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg backward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are bent comfortably.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
breathing: Inhale as you step back and lower.
Exhale as you come back up.
careful_about: Keep the front knee stable.
Do not lean too far forward.
Take a controlled step, not a jump.

steps: Place one foot firmly on a stable chair or step.
Lean slightly forward and push through the elevated leg.
Bring your body up until you are standing on the chair.
Step back down under control and repeat.
careful_about: Use a stable surface that will not slip.
Do not push too much with the back leg.
Keep the working knee aligned with the foot.

steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push hips back while keeping a slight bend in the knees.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive hips forward to stand back up.
breathing: Exhale as you return to standing.
careful_about: Keep the back neutral.
Do not squat the movement down.
Stop when you lose hamstring tension or back position.

steps: Place dumbbells on the floor in front of your feet.
Hinge down and grip the dumbbells with a flat back.
Stand up by driving through your feet and extending the hips.
Lower the dumbbells back to the floor with control.
careful_about: Do not round your lower back.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Move smoothly instead of jerking.

steps: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward while sending the free leg straight back.
Keep hips square and lower with control.
Return to standing by driving the standing hip forward.
breathing: Exhale as you come back up.
careful_about: Do not twist the hips open.
Keep a soft knee on the standing leg.
Use a wall or chair for balance if needed.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your hips back down with control.
breathing: Exhale as you lift the hips.
careful_about: Do not over-arch your lower back.
Push through your heels, not your toes.
Keep the movement controlled.

steps: Lie on your back and extend one leg straight.
Keep the other foot flat on the floor.
Lift your hips by squeezing the working glute.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
breathing: Exhale as you raise your hips.
careful_about: Keep hips level.
Do not let the lower back take over.
Use a smaller range if balance is unstable.

steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the weight back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to swing the weight up.
Let the arms guide the weight; the hips create the power.
breathing: Exhale sharply as you drive the hips forward.
careful_about: Do not squat the movement.
Keep your back neutral.
Use a controlled dumbbell that you can handle safely.

steps: Stand upright with feet about hip-width apart.
Lift your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
careful_about: Do not bounce at the bottom.
Keep the motion controlled.
Avoid leaning too far forward.

steps: Stand on one foot and keep the other leg lifted.
Raise your heel as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
careful_about: Use support if balance is difficult.
Do not rush the lowering phase.
Keep the ankle moving through a full range.

steps: Start in a straight plank position with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
careful_about: Do not let your hips sag.
Do not flare elbows excessively.
Keep your neck neutral.

steps: Place your hands on a stable elevated surface.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the surface.
Press back up to the starting position.
careful_about: Make sure the surface is stable.
Do not bend at the hips.
Keep shoulders controlled and not shrugged.

steps: Start with your knees on the floor and hands under shoulders.
Keep your hips and shoulders aligned.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up to full arm extension.
careful_about: Do not arch your lower back.
Keep your core engaged.
Move through a controlled range.

steps: Place your hands on an elevated surface and keep your knees on the floor.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the surface.
Push back up under control.
careful_about: Keep the surface stable.
Do not let your hips sink.
Use a height that feels manageable.

steps: Place your feet on a raised surface and hands on the floor.
Keep your body straight and brace your core.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to the starting position.
careful_about: Do not let your lower back sag.
Keep your neck neutral.
Use a low elevation first if needed.

steps: Start in a push-up position with hands placed closer together.
Lower your chest while keeping elbows tucked more than usual.
Keep your torso straight.
Push back up by extending the elbows.
careful_about: Do not place hands too close if it hurts wrists.
Keep elbows from flaring out too much.
Maintain a tight core.

steps: Place your feet on a stable elevated surface.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up while keeping the core tight.
careful_about: Make sure the foot support is stable.
Do not overarch the lower back.
Start with a low elevation if needed.

steps: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Brace your core and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out at the top without shrugging excessively.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level.
careful_about: Do not arch your lower back.
Keep ribs down and core tight.
Use a controlled path overhead.

steps: Sit tall with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells straight overhead.
Pause briefly near lockout.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.
careful_about: Keep your back supported if possible.
Do not overarch the spine.
Avoid banging the dumbbells together overhead.

steps: Start with dumbbells in front of your shoulders and palms facing you.
Rotate the palms outward as you press up.
Reach overhead with control.
Reverse the movement as you lower.
breathing: Exhale as you press and rotate up.
careful_about: Move slowly and smoothly.
Do not let the lower back arch.
Keep the shoulders controlled through the rotation.

steps: Start in a pike position with hips raised high.
Bend your elbows and lower the head toward the floor.
Keep most of the load on the shoulders.
Press back up to the starting pike position.
careful_about: Keep the head movement controlled.
Do not let the shoulders collapse.
Use a smaller range if the movement is too hard.

steps: Place your hands on the edge of a stable chair or bench.
Extend your legs forward and lower your hips by bending the elbows.
Descend until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press through your palms to return to the top.
breathing: Exhale as you push back up.
careful_about: Keep the chair or bench stable.
Do not let your shoulders shrug up.
Avoid going too deep if it irritates the shoulders.

steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend the elbows to raise the dumbbell back overhead.
careful_about: Do not flare the elbows outward too much.
Keep your core braced so the lower back does not arch.
Use a controlled range of motion.

steps: Lie on your back and hold dumbbells above your chest.
Keep your upper arms mostly still.
Lower the dumbbells by bending only at the elbows.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
careful_about: Keep elbows steady and avoid drifting them wide.
Do not let the weights crash toward your face.
Lower with control instead of dropping fast.

steps: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above your chest.
Point the elbows outward slightly.
Lower the dumbbells toward the upper chest by bending the elbows.
Press the dumbbells back up under control.
careful_about: Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Do not let the elbows collapse too far inward.
Use light weight first to learn the path.

steps: Place one hand and knee on a chair or bench for support.
Let the dumbbell hang with a straight arm.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip.
Lower it back down with control.
careful_about: Do not twist your torso to cheat the rep.
Keep your back flat.
Pull toward the hip, not straight up to the shoulder.

steps: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips.
Keep your back flat and chest open.
Pull the dumbbells toward your lower ribs or hips.
Lower them slowly back to the starting position.
careful_about: Do not round your lower back.
Avoid jerking the weights.
Keep the neck neutral and gaze slightly forward.

steps: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell under each hand.
Brace your core and row one dumbbell toward your hip.
Lower it back down without twisting too much.
Repeat on the other side.
breathing: Exhale as you row the dumbbell up.
careful_about: Keep hips as level as possible.
Do not let the lower back sag.
Use lighter dumbbells until your plank is stable.

steps: Hinge forward slightly with dumbbells hanging below you.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lift the dumbbells out to the sides.
Lower them slowly back down.
careful_about: Do not use momentum.
Keep shoulders away from your ears.
Use light weight and focus on control.

steps: Hinge forward with a flat back and dumbbells hanging below you.
Raise the dumbbells outward and slightly back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly with control.
careful_about: Do not swing the weights.
Do not shrug the shoulders.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips.
Return them to the starting position with control.
breathing: Inhale as you return to the start.
Exhale as you sweep the arms around.
careful_about: Keep the neck relaxed.
Do not force a big range of motion.
Move slowly to keep tension on the rear delts.

steps: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.
careful_about: Do not swing your body.
Keep elbows fixed in place.
Control the lowering phase.

steps: Stand holding dumbbells in both hands.
Curl one arm up while the other stays down.
Lower it and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating.
breathing: Exhale as you lift each arm.
careful_about: Avoid leaning back.
Keep movement slow and controlled.
Do not rush between reps.

steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing inward.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Curl the weights up without rotating wrists.
Lower them slowly.
careful_about: Do not swing the weights.
Keep wrists neutral.
Maintain control throughout.

steps: Sit and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Hold a dumbbell and let it hang down.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly to full extension.
careful_about: Do not move your upper arm.
Avoid using momentum.
Focus on slow, controlled reps.

steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing up.
Curl your wrists upward.
Lower slowly.
careful_about: Move only the wrists.
Use light weight.
Avoid jerky movement.

steps: Get into a forearm plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and hold.
Maintain position for time.
careful_about: Do not let hips sag or rise.
Keep neck neutral.
Engage core throughout.

steps: Lie on your side and support yourself on one forearm.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold the position.
careful_about: Do not let hips drop.
Keep shoulders stacked.
Maintain alignment.

steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs raised.
Lower opposite arm and leg slowly.
Return to start.
Alternate sides.
careful_about: Keep lower back pressed to the floor.
Move slowly.
Avoid arching your back.

steps: Lie on your back and lift arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Press your lower back into the ground.
Hold the position.
Maintain tension throughout.
careful_about: Do not arch your lower back.
Keep core tight.
Start with easier variations if needed.

steps: Start standing.
Drop into a squat and place hands on the floor.
Jump feet back into a plank.
Return feet forward and jump up.
careful_about: Land softly.
Maintain control in plank.
Avoid rushing with poor form.

steps: Start in a plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Continue alternating.
careful_about: Keep hips low.
Do not bounce excessively.
Maintain a strong plank.

steps: Hold dumbbells at shoulder level.
Perform a squat.
As you stand, press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower back to starting position.
careful_about: Keep your back straight.
Do not rush the movement.
Use controlled transitions between squat and press.
